title: A Hierarchical Method for Environmental Sounds Recognition in Complex Acoustic Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2610.34931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Environmental noise identification is essential for noise control, yet conventional single-stage classifiers suffer from class confusion under imbalanced multiclass conditions. This paper proposes a lightweight hierarchical model integrating a Frequency-Time Adaptive Network (FTANet) with a two-stage classification mechanism. FTANet employs parallel asymmetric one-dimensional convolutions to capture temporal dynamics and frequency-band distributions, while adaptive fusion attention (AFA) enhances discriminative acoustic features. In the first stage, FTANet classifies sounds into five coarse-grained categories covering 25 fine-grained classes. In the second stage, samples are routed to the corresponding category-specific classifiers for fine-grained recognition. translated_title: 一种用于复杂声学场景中环境声音识别的分层方法
translated_abstract: 环境噪声识别对于噪声控制至关重要，然而传统的单阶段分类器在不平衡多分类条件下会出现类别混淆问题。本文提出了一种轻量级分层模型，该模型集成了频率-时间自适应网络（FTANet）与两阶段分类机制。FTANet采用并行非对称一维卷积来捕捉时间动态特性和频带分布，同时自适应融合注意力机制（AFA）用于增强具有判别性的声学特征。在第一阶段，FTANet将声音分类为五个粗粒度类别，涵盖25个细粒度类别。在第二阶段，样本被路由到相应的类别专用分类器中进行细粒度识别。在自建数据集上，FTANet仅使用0.2004M参数即达到95.45%的粗粒度准确率。在UrbanSound8K数据集上，它达到了79.24%的平均准确率和80.37%的平均F1分数。
tldr: 本文提出一种融合频率-时间自适应网络与两阶段分类机制的轻量级分层模型，有效解决了复杂声学场景中不平衡多分类条件下的环境声音识别类别混淆问题，并以极少参数量取得了优异的识别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight hierarchical model integrating a Frequency-Time Adaptive Network with a two-stage classification mechanism, which effectively addresses class confusion in environmental sound recognition under imbalanced multiclass conditions while achieving excellent performance with minimal parameters.
